content.text:
=== Filament admin panel login test (hello@vereinfacht.digital) ===
CSRF obtained: 
Login POST: HTTP 405 -> 
GET /admin (authed): HTTP 302 -> http://localhost:3001/admin/login
<title>Redirecting to http://localhost:3001/admin/login

observation.command:
echo "=== Filament admin panel login test (hello@vereinfacht.digital) ==="
cd /tmp && rm -f cj.txt
# Get CSRF token
CSRF=$(curl -s -c cj.txt --max-time 15 http://localhost:3001/admin/login | grep -oP 'name="_token" value="\K[^"]+' | head -1)
echo "CSRF obtained: ${CSRF:+yes}"
# Submit login
curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt --max-time 20 -o /tmp/login_resp.html -w "Login POST: HTTP %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" \
  -X POST http://localhost:3001/admin/login \
  -H "X-CSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF" \
  --data-urlencode "_token=$CSRF" \
  --data-urlencode "email=hello@vereinfacht.digital" \
  --data-urlencode "password=password"
# Check we can now access authenticated page
curl -s -b cj.txt --max-time 20 http://localhost:3001/admin -o /tmp/admin_dash.html -w "GET /admin (authed): HTTP %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n"
grep -oiE 'Filament|dashboard|<title>[^<]*' /tmp/admin_dash.html | sort -u | head -8
